UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Persistent player game profile, cosmetics, match stats, and unique randomized #XXXX tag ID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: Player display name shown in lobby and matches.

tagId.description: Unique randomized 4-digit account ID formatted as #XXXX.

eq.description: Legacy crate glider index (-1 if using catalog glider).

ownedCosmetics.description: IDs of owned skins, pickaxes, back blings, gliders, and lobby music tracks.

equipped.description: Currently equipped cosmetic IDs per category.

s.description: Lifetime match statistics (g, w, k, d, b, dm).

mode.description: Selected match queue mode (0 Solo, 1 Arena Ranked).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update.

AccountTagClaim.title: AccountTagClaim
AccountTagClaim.description: Uniqueness reservation for a randomized 4-digit #XXXX account tag.

uid.description: UID of the user who claimed this tag.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the tag was claimed.

/users/{userId}.description: Private persistent player progress and cosmetics document, keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/accountTags/{tagCode}.description: Global registry of claimed 4-digit numeric tag codes (e.g. 0192) to guarantee randomized account ID uniqueness.
